entities.summary: Gjon Buzuku was a prominent Albanian Catholic priest and author from the Renaissance, who wrote the first known printed book in Albanian, commonly referred to as the Missal. Published in 1555, this book is considered a crucial monument of Albanian studies, providing the oldest source for studying the Albanian language. The Missal's significance lies in its role as a bridge between the ancient and modern eras of Albanian culture. It also highlights the importance of the Catholic Church in the spread of literacy and education in Albania during the 16th century. The Missal's impact can be seen in the development of Albanian literature and language, with its influence still felt today.
